title: Heartpouch
description: Heart Pouch is a quality-of-life addon for the Heartstone mod. It introduces a bundle-like item to help storing heartstones.
body:
🦝 About 🦝

Heart Pouch is a quality-of-life addon for Heartstone.
It allows you to store, manage, and switch between multiple Heartstones using a single inventory slot.

No more inventory clutter.
No more digging through chests or backpacks.
One pouch. Many bonds. ❤️

✨ Features ✨

  • Multiple Heartstones, One Slot
    Store several Heartstones inside a single pouch item.
  • Instant Switching
    Hold SHIFT + Mouse Wheel to cycle through stored Heartstones.
  • Active Heart Usage
    Right-click the pouch to use the currently selected Heartstone as if it were in your hand.
  • Clear Visual Feedback
    Tooltips display:
    • All stored Heartstones
    • Custom names (if present)
    • Which Heartstone is currently active
  • Inventory & Container Support
    Works while:
    • Holding the pouch
    • Hovering it in inventories
    • Using containers

Smooth and intuitive in any context.

🖱️ How to Use 🖱️

  • Insert a Heartstone
    Right-click a Heartstone with the pouch in your inventory (or vice versa) to store it.
  • Remove the Active Heartstone
    Right-click the pouch with an empty cursor.
  • Switch Active Heartstone
    Hold SHIFT and scroll the mouse wheel while holding the pouch in your hand or hovering over it in an inventory/container.
  • Use the Pouch
    Right-click normally to activate the selected Heartstone.

🔗 Compatibility 🔗

  • Requires Heartstone
  • Requires RaccoonCore
  • Designed for Forge only, at least for now
  • Should work fine with any other mods! But if it doesn't, please let me know by opening an issue here or on GitHub!
